'''6 June 2024 Thursday Night SWCCG after Dark''' was a Star Wars CCG tournament on 6 June 2024. [[Eddie Szwabowski]] won it.<ref name="afterdark">[https://discord.com/channels/809922418096996364/1248470769294643331/1248525008737931335 Congratulations to Nrabbit for winning tonight's SWCCG After Dark], LargePorg, Star Wars CCG Retro Club Discord (7 June 2024).</ref>

[[Thomas Santosuosso]] posted the standings. The sheet lists four rows.<ref name="afterdark" />

The second-place row was entered as the handles cystx, Teacher, and frodo. Those are [[Ian Monteith]] (cstyx), [[Charles Hickey]] (Teacher), and [[Brian Avery]] (frodolight). [[Thomas Santosuosso]] said each of them played one game.<ref name="onegame">[https://discord.com/channels/809922418096996364/1248470769294643331/1248642792432074864 did Teacher/frodo/styx only play one game each?], cmoore89, Star Wars CCG Retro Club Discord (7 June 2024).</ref><ref name="theydid">[https://discord.com/channels/809922418096996364/1248470769294643331/1248680307729633321 They did], LargePorg, Star Wars CCG Retro Club Discord (7 June 2024).</ref>
